senses.label: Melancholy and the humours
senses.summary: Lasting fear and despondency are a bodily condition, melancholia, caused by an excess of black bile.
markers: fear without cause comes from the body's humours
hazards: 'Anxiety' is not a modern word here: Cicero already distinguishes anxietas, a lasting trait, from angor, a passing distress.

sources.note: Fear and despondency lasting a long time indicate melancholia.

senses.label: Nervous disorders (neuroses)
senses.summary: Disorders of sense and motion are disorders of the nervous system without fever or local disease.
markers: mental suffering is a disease of the nerves

senses.label: Anxiety neurosis
senses.summary: Anxiety is a distinct clinical syndrome with psychological causes, separated from other nervous complaints.
markers: anxiety is a separate illness with its own cause

sources.citation: Sigmund Freud, 'On the grounds for detaching a particular syndrome from neurasthenia under the description "anxiety neurosis"' (1895)

senses.label: Anxiety disorder as a diagnosis
senses.summary: Anxiety disorders are defined by standard diagnostic criteria and treated as medical conditions.
markers: excessive worry for months meets criteria for a diagnosable disorder
anxiety is treated by medical professionals like other illness
